why: Same notions on both sides (range Dr(x) = T_xO, reducedTangentSpaceWith, partialConeWith, ofSubspace/IsPartialQuadrant, d_O = degIndex of LocalModel.toMPolyfold). A ⇒ B: A is stated for a retraction R₀ tame w.r.t. the given presentation T, B for EVERY retraction R onto O; glue: range Dr(x) does not depend on the retraction (tangentSpace_eq_range, i.e. Prop 2.4), so T^R_xO and C_xO for R and R₀ coincide; B's cardinal Module.rank codimension equals the ℕ-valued quotDim because the quotient embeds into the finite-dimensional E/E_x. B ⇒ A: the retract statements are B applied to r(U), tame by IsTameWith.isTame (one presentation suffices); the M-polyfold statements degIndex_eq_chartDegIndex_of_isTameWith/_of_isTameRetract (a chart on a tame retract realizes d_X) follow from B's (14) for the chart's local model plus Proposition 2.24 along the chart, after proving (new glue, ~50 lines) that a chart φ : V → O is an sc-diffeomorphism onto the M-polyfold O. Three conjuncts are elementary linear algebra and were proved directly without B: quotDim_eq_finrank_quotient_of_isCompl, isPartialQuadrant_ofSubspace (from the def splitIso), and quotDim_reducedTangentSpaceWith_eq — the latter is slightly more general than the text/B since its T is any sc-iso E ≅ ℝⁿ ⊕ W, not necessarily a presentation of C, so B could not supply it.
overlap: 241 shared project theorems: sc-calculus/retract/chart infrastructure (IsSc*, lvlSet, MChart.*, IsScSmoothRetractMap.*, compatible_of_locally), the splitIso helper lemmas (via the definition splitIso), finrank_quotient_minimalSubspaceWith (in the direct proof of quotDim_reducedTangentSpaceWith_eq), IsTameWith.exists_complement/degIndex_apply (structure projections), MPolyfold.degIndex_le and exists_isChart_degIndex_eq (via proposition_2_4_4); none of the item's theorems.
